name: Also (Rivian spinout)
industry: electric bikes and small electric vehicles
desc: Micromobility company spun out of Rivian that sells an electric bike and is developing small autonomous delivery vehicles.
ownership: founder-led, venture-backed (Prysm Capital, Eclipse, Greenoaks, MVP Ventures); Rivian holds a minority stake
capacity_detail: USD 150M Series D led by Prysm Capital at a valuation above USD 1bn (August 2026), taking total funding to USD 455M
markets: United States; Amazon and DoorDash are named as customers

signals.raise: USD 150M Series D at a valuation above USD 1bn (Aug 2026; https://thenextweb.com/news/also-rivian-spinout-150m-series-d-autonomous)

rationale: Well-funded new mobility brand linked to Rivian; electric and autonomous vehicle makers already use motorsport to build consumer awareness.
